scanNote:
13-UNITNING UChINChI BETI (94-bet) - KIYIMLAR, YO'L KO'RSATISh.

Yuqorida chapda KO'K yorliqda oq '13' va 'Join in the Fun!'.

CHAP USTUN:
8) 'The people in the pictures are going to a fancy-dress party. Look at them and say what they are going as (tourist, waitress, detective, pilot, gangster, schoolgirl) and what they are wearing, as in the example.' SURATLAR: A - ofitsiant ayol: apron, uniform, tights, flat shoes. B - sayyoh: straw hat, shirt, Bermuda shorts, trainers. C - gangster: tie, suit (shlyapa, jomadon). D - detektiv: waistcoat, coat, cloak, trousers (Sherlock Holmes uslubi, lupa). E - uchuvchi: scarf, leather jacket, breeches, boots. F - maktab o'quvchisi qiz: jacket, skirt, socks. Ko'k qiya: 'A is going to the fancy-dress party as a waitress. She's wearing a blue uniform with an apron, black tights and flat black shoes.'
9) 'Fill in the correct adjectives from the lists, then act out the dialogues in pairs.' Qiya: 'boring - terrible - disgusting'. 1 A: Did you enjoy the party last night? B: No, I didn't. It was ...... . A: Really? What about the food? B: It was ......, and the people were really ...... . Qiya: 'delicious - brilliant - interesting'. 2 A: How was the party? B: It was ...... . Actually, it was the best party I've ever been to. A: What about the food? B: It was ......, and the people were really ...... . I'm sorry you couldn't make it.

O'NG USTUN:
• To'q sariq 'Communication: Giving Directions'.
10) Kasseta belgisi: 'Listen and complete the dialogue. Then, in pairs, act out similar dialogues giving directions • from the supermarket to Hampton School; • from Star Bowling to the supermarket. Use the expressions below.' Qiya: 'go down/along ....', 'turn left/right', 'take the first/second, etc turning on the/your left/right'.
   XARITA: GEORGE STREET (vertikal, markazda), HAMPTON STREET (gorizontal, yuqori), WEST STREET (gorizontal, o'rta), GREEN STREET (gorizontal, past). Yuqorida chapda HAMPTON SCHOOL (avtobus), yuqorida markazda ST GEORGE'S CHURCH, yuqorida o'ngda STAR BOWLING, pastda o'ngda SUPERMARKET va HAMPTON PARK, daryo. Pastda chapda bola, to'q sariq strelka o'ngga (Green Street bo'ylab sharqqa). Svetoforlar George Street va Green Street kesishmasida.
   A: Excuse me. Is there a bowling alley near here? B: Yes, there is. It's 1) ...... Hampton Street. A: How do I get there? B: Go 2) ...... this street and turn 3) ...... at the traffic lights. Then, take the second turning on the 4) ...... into Hampton Street. The bowling alley is about 100 metres down the street 5) ...... your right.
11) Kasseta belgisi: 'Listen and tick the things which are going to happen at Jane's party, then make sentences about her party, as in the example.' 1 they/have a buffet 2 Jane's mum/bake a cake 3 they/go bowling 4 Jane/blow out candles 5 father/make a speech 6 they/play party games 7 they/dance 8 magician/perform tricks. Ko'k qiya: 'They are going to have a buffet.'
• To'q sariq 'Writing (Project)': 'Use the information in Ex. 11 to complete Jane's letter in the Photo File section.'

Bet raqami: pastda chapda '94'.

exercises.instructionEn: The people in the pictures are going to a fancy-dress party. Look at them and say what they are going as (tourist, waitress, detective, pilot, gangster, schoolgirl) and what they are wearing, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: Suratlardagi odamlar maskarad bazmiga bormoqda. Ularga qarang va kim bo'lib borayotganini (sayyoh, ofitsiant ayol, detektiv, uchuvchi, gangster, maktab o'quvchisi qiz) va nima kiyganini ayting, namunadagidek.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  'A is going to the fancy-dress
   party as a waitress. She's
   wearing a blue uniform with an
   apron, black tights and flat
   black shoes.'


KIYIMLAR (suratdagi yorliqlar):

  A - WAITRESS: apron (fartuk),
      uniform (forma), tights
      (kolgotka), flat shoes (poshnasiz
      tufli)
  B - TOURIST: straw hat (somon
      shlyapa), shirt (ko'ylak),
      Bermuda shorts (uzun shortik),
      trainers (krossovka)
  C - GANGSTER: suit (kostyum), tie
      (galstuk), hat
  D - DETECTIVE: coat (palto), cloak
      (plash), waistcoat (nimcha),
      trousers (shim)
  E - PILOT: leather jacket (teri
      kurtka), scarf (sharf),
      breeches (uchuvchi shimi), boots
      (etik)
  F - SCHOOLGIRL: jacket (pidjak),
      skirt (yubka), socks (paypoq)


⚠ 'A FANCY-DRESS PARTY':

  = maskarad bazmi (kostyumli).


⚠ 'TO GO AS':

  = ... bo'lib bormoq.
  'She's going AS a waitress.'


⚠ 'TIGHTS':

  = kolgotka. Ko'plik shaklda.


⚠ 'TRAINERS':

  = krossovka (BrE).
  ⚠ AmE 'sneakers'.


⚠ 'A WAISTCOAT':

  = nimcha. /ˈweɪskəʊt/.


⚠ 'A CLOAK':

  = plash (yengsiz).


⚠ 'BREECHES':

  = kalta shim (uchuvchi/otliq).

exercises.exampleUz: A maskarad bazmiga ofitsiant ayol bo'lib bormoqda. U fartukli ko'k forma, qora kolgotka va poshnasiz qora tufli kiygan.
modelAnswers: B is going to the fancy-dress party as a tourist. He's wearing a straw hat, a colourful shirt, Bermuda shorts and trainers.
C is going to the fancy-dress party as a gangster. He's wearing a dark suit, a tie and a hat.
D is going to the fancy-dress party as a detective. He's wearing a long coat with a cloak, a waistcoat and trousers.
E is going to the fancy-dress party as a pilot. She's wearing a leather jacket, a white scarf, breeches and boots.

modelAnswersUz: B maskarad bazmiga sayyoh bo'lib bormoqda. U somon shlyapa, rangli ko'ylak, uzun shortik va krossovka kiygan.
C maskarad bazmiga gangster bo'lib bormoqda. U to'q kostyum, galstuk va shlyapa kiygan.
D maskarad bazmiga detektiv bo'lib bormoqda. U plashli uzun palto, nimcha va shim kiygan.
E maskarad bazmiga uchuvchi bo'lib bormoqda. U teri kurtka, oq sharf, kalta shim va etik kiygan.
F maskarad bazmiga maktab o'quvchisi qiz bo'lib bormoqda. U ko'k pidjak, ko'k yubka va paypoq kiygan.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the correct adjectives from the lists, then act out the dialogues in pairs. Dialogue 1: boring - terrible - disgusting. Dialogue 2: delicious - brilliant - interesting
exercises.instructionUz: Ro'yxatlardagi to'g'ri sifatlarni qo'ying, keyin juftlikda dialoglarni o'ynang. 1-dialog: boring - terrible - disgusting. 2-dialog: delicious - brilliant - interesting
exercises.explanationUz:
JAVOBLAR:

  1-DIALOG (salbiy):
    party → TERRIBLE
    food → DISGUSTING
    people → BORING

  2-DIALOG (ijobiy):
    party → BRILLIANT
    food → DELICIOUS
    people → INTERESTING

  ⚠ Ovqat → disgusting/delicious.
  ⚠ Odamlar → boring/interesting.
  ⚠ Bazm → terrible/brilliant.


⚠ 'ACTUALLY':

  = aslida.


⚠ 'THE BEST ... I'VE EVER BEEN TO':

  = borgan eng yaxshi ...
  ⚠ Superlative + present perfect.


⚠ 'TO MAKE IT':

  = kela olmoq, ulgurmoq.
  'you couldn't make it' = kela
  olmadingiz.

exercises.instructionEn: Listen and complete the dialogue. Then, in pairs, act out similar dialogues giving directions from the supermarket to Hampton School; from Star Bowling to the supermarket. Use the expressions below: go down/along ...; turn left/right; take the first/second, etc turning on the/your left/right
exercises.instructionUz: Tinglang va dialogni to'ldiring. Keyin juftlikda supermarketdan Hampton maktabiga; Star Bowlingdan supermarketga yo'l ko'rsatuvchi shunga o'xshash dialoglarni o'ynang. Quyidagi iboralardan foydalaning: go down/along ...; turn left/right; take the first/second, etc turning on the/your left/right
exercises.explanationUz:
⚠ Audio yo'q bo'lsa - xaritadan
tekshiring.


XARITA:
  Bola GREEN STREET da (pastda
  chapda), sharqqa qaramoqda.
  GEORGE STREET - vertikal, markazda.
  Ko'chalar (pastdan yuqoriga):
  Green St → West St → Hampton St.


JAVOBLAR:
  1 in (It's IN Hampton Street)
  2 along / down
  3 left (svetoforda chapga - George
    Street bo'ylab shimolga)
  4 right (ikkinchi burilish o'ngga -
    Hampton Street; birinchisi West
    Street)
  5 on (ON your right)


YO'L KO'RSATISh IBORALARI:

  Excuse me. Is there a ... near
    here? = Kechirasiz, yaqinda ...
    bormi?
  How do I get there? = U yerga
    qanday boraman?
  Go along/down this street = Bu
    ko'cha bo'ylab boring
  Turn left/right at the traffic
    lights = Svetoforda chapga/
    o'ngga buriling
  Take the second turning on the
    right = Ikkinchi burilishda
    o'ngga buriling
  It's on your right/left = U o'ng/
    chap tomoningizda


⚠ 'A BOWLING ALLEY':

  = bouling zali.


⚠ 'TRAFFIC LIGHTS':

  = svetofor. Ko'plik!


⚠ 'A TURNING':

  = burilish (ko'cha).


⚠ 'IN ... STREET' (BrE):

  = ... ko'chasida.
  ⚠ AmE 'on ... Street'.

exercises.instructionEn: In pairs, act out similar dialogues giving directions.
exercises.instructionUz: Juftlikda yo'l ko'rsatuvchi shunga o'xshash dialoglarni o'ynang.
exercises.explanationUz:
XARITA BO'YIChA:

  SUPERMARKET → HAMPTON SCHOOL:
  Supermarket - George St va Green
  St burchagida (sharqda). George
  Street bo'ylab shimolga, Hampton
  Streetga chapga; maktab chap
  tomonda.

  STAR BOWLING → SUPERMARKET:
  Hampton Street bo'ylab g'arbga,
  George Streetga chapga (janubga),
  Green Streetgacha; supermarket
  chap tomonda (burchakda).

items.prompt: from the supermarket to Hampton School
items.question: Excuse me. Is there a school near here? How do I get there?
items.answer: Yes, there is. It's in Hampton Street. Go up George Street and take the second turning on the left into Hampton Street. Hampton School is about 100 metres down the street on your left.
items.whyUz: ⚠ George St shimolga: 1-West St, 2-Hampton St chapga.

items.prompt: from Star Bowling to the supermarket
items.question: Excuse me. Is there a supermarket near here? How do I get there?
items.answer: Yes, there is. It's in Green Street. Go along Hampton Street and turn left into George Street. Go down George Street to the traffic lights. The supermarket is on the corner, on your left.
items.whyUz: ⚠ Hampton St g'arbga, George St janubga, Green St burchagida.

exercises.instructionEn: Listen and tick the things which are going to happen at Jane's party, then make sentences about her party, as in the example. 1 they/have a buffet 2 Jane's mum/bake a cake 3 they/go bowling 4 Jane/blow out candles 5 father/make a speech 6 they/play party games 7 they/dance 8 magician/perform tricks
exercises.instructionUz: Tinglang va Jane bazmida bo'ladigan narsalarni belgilang, keyin namunadagidek uning bazmi haqida gaplar tuzing. 1 they/have a buffet 2 Jane's mum/bake a cake 3 they/go bowling 4 Jane/blow out candles 5 father/make a speech 6 they/play party games 7 they/dance 8 magician/perform tricks
exercises.explanationUz:
JAVOBLAR (Photo File bo'limidagi
Jane xatidan):
  1 ✓ buffet  2 ✓ cake
  3 ✗ bowling  4 ✓ candles
  5 ✓ speech  6 ✓ games
  7 ✓ dance  8 ✗ magician
  (rejalashtirilgan, lekin bekor
  qilingan)


KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  'They are going to have a buffet.'


⚠ 'BE GOING TO':

  = rejalashtirilgan kelajak.


⚠ 'A BUFFET':

  = bufet (o'zi-o'ziga xizmat
  dasturxoni). /ˈbʊfeɪ/ - 't'
  o'qilmaydi.


⚠ 'TO BAKE':

  = pishirmoq (tandirda/pechda).


⚠ 'TO BLOW OUT CANDLES':

  = shamlarni puflab o'chirmoq.


⚠ 'TO MAKE A SPEECH':

  = nutq so'zlamoq.


⚠ 'A MAGICIAN':

  = sehrgar, fokuschi.


⚠ 'TO PERFORM TRICKS':

  = fokus ko'rsatmoq.

items.sentence: 1 They are going to have a buffet.
2 Jane's mum is going to bake a cake.
3 They are going to go bowling.
items.whyUz: ⚠ Photo File xatida bouling tilga olinmagan - bo'lmaydi.

items.sentence: 4 Jane is going to blow out candles.
5 Her father is going to make a speech.
items.whyUz: ⚠ Photo File xatida: 'my father is going to make a speech' - BO'LADI.

items.sentence: 6 They are going to play party games.
8 A magician is going to perform tricks.
items.whyUz: ⚠ Photo File xatida: 'We were planning to have a magician ... but then we decided not to' - BO'LMAYDI.
